steps.title: Агрегаты, HAVING и разворот в колонки
steps.content:
## Агрегация и pivot

- `COUNT(DISTINCT x)` считает **разные** значения, `COUNT(x)` — непустые.
- `HAVING` фильтрует группы; агрегат можно сравнивать с агрегатом (`HAVING SUM(a) > 10000`).
- «Разворот» в колонки — `SUM(CASE WHEN month = … THEN revenue END)` по одной колонке на месяц.
- Целочисленное деление в SQLite: `SUM(x) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)`, иначе дробная часть теряется.

content.caption: Условный SUM(CASE …) строит колонки-месяцы
content.description: Pivot одной таблицы без отдельного pivot-оператора.

content.setup: CREATE TABLE Person(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT email FROM Person GROUP BY email HAVING COUNT(*) = 1;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT email FROM Person GROUP BY email HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

content.description:
Для каждого `player_id` — дата первой игры как `first_login`.

[LeetCode 511](https://leetcode.com/problems/game-play-analysis-i/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Activity(player_id INTEGER NOT NULL, device_id INTEGER NOT NULL, event_date TEXT NOT NULL, games_played INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT player_id, MAX(event_date) AS first_login FROM Activity GROUP BY player_id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT player_id, MIN(event_date) AS first_login FROM Activity GROUP BY player_id;

steps.title: 586. Customer Placing the Largest Number of Orders

content.setup: CREATE TABLE Orders(order_number INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_number INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT customer_number FROM Orders GROUP BY customer_number ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC LIMIT 1;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT customer_number FROM Orders GROUP BY customer_number ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

steps.title: 1050. Actors and Directors Who Cooperated At Least Three Times

content.setup: CREATE TABLE ActorDirector(actor_id INTEGER NOT NULL, director_id INTEGER NOT NULL, timestamp INTEGER PRIMARY KEY);
content.starterCode: SELECT actor_id, director_id FROM ActorDirector GROUP BY actor_id, director_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT actor_id, director_id FROM ActorDirector GROUP BY actor_id, director_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3;

content.description:
`product_id`, `product_name` товаров, которые продавались **только** в первом квартале 2019 (`2019-01-01`–`2019-03-31`).

[LeetCode 1084](https://leetcode.com/problems/sales-analysis-iii/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Product(product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product_name TEXT NOT NULL, unit_price INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Sales(seller_id INTEGER NOT NULL, product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, buyer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, sale_date TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, price INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM Product p JOIN Sales s ON p.product_id = s.product_id WHERE s.sale_date BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-03-31';
content.referenceSolution: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM Product p JOIN Sales s ON p.product_id = s.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id HAVING MIN(s.sale_date) >= '2019-01-01' AND MAX(s.sale_date) <= '2019-03-31';

content.description:
Разверните `Department` по месяцам: колонки `id`, `Jan_Revenue`, …, `Dec_Revenue`; сумма `revenue` за месяц и `id`, `NULL` если данных нет. Сортировка по `id`.

[LeetCode 1179](https://leetcode.com/problems/reformat-department-table/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Department(id INTEGER NOT NULL, revenue INTEGER NOT NULL, month TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT id, revenue, month FROM Department ORDER BY id;
content.referenceSolution:
SELECT id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = 'Jan' THEN revenue END) AS Jan_Revenue,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = 'Feb' THEN revenue END) AS Feb_Revenue,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = 'Mar' THEN revenue END) AS Mar_Revenue,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = 'Apr' THEN revenue END) AS Apr_Revenue,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = 'May' THEN revenue END) AS May_Revenue,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = 'Jun' THEN revenue END) AS Jun_Revenue,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = 'Jul' THEN revenue END) AS Jul_Revenue,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = 'Aug' THEN revenue END) AS Aug_Revenue,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = 'Sep' THEN revenue END) AS Sep_Revenue,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = 'Oct' THEN revenue END) AS Oct_Revenue,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = 'Nov' THEN revenue END) AS Nov_Revenue,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = 'Dec' THEN revenue END) AS Dec_Revenue
FROM Department GROUP BY id ORDER BY id;

content.description:
Имя владельца (`name`) и `balance` — сумма всех транзакций по счёту, если она **больше 10000**.

[LeetCode 1587](https://leetcode.com/problems/bank-account-summary-ii/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Users(account INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Transactions(trans_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, account INTEGER NOT NULL, amount INTEGER NOT NULL, trans_date TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT u.name, SUM(t.amount) AS balance FROM Users u JOIN Transactions t ON u.account = t.account GROUP BY u.account;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT u.name, SUM(t.amount) AS balance FROM Users u JOIN Transactions t ON u.account = t.account GROUP BY u.account HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 10000;

content.setup: CREATE TABLE DailySales(date_id TEXT NOT NULL, make_name TEXT NOT NULL, lead_id INTEGER NOT NULL, partner_id INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT date_id, make_name, COUNT(lead_id) AS unique_leads, COUNT(partner_id) AS unique_partners FROM DailySales GROUP BY date_id, make_name;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT date_id, make_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lead_id) AS unique_leads, COUNT(DISTINCT partner_id) AS unique_partners FROM DailySales GROUP BY date_id, make_name;

steps.title: 1741. Find Total Time Spent by Each Employee

content.description:
Для пары `(emp_id, event_day)`: `day` и `total_time` = сумма `out_time - in_time`.

[LeetCode 1741](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-total-time-spent-by-each-employee/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Employees(emp_id INTEGER NOT NULL, event_day TEXT NOT NULL, in_time INTEGER NOT NULL, out_time INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT event_day AS day, emp_id, SUM(out_time + in_time) AS total_time FROM Employees GROUP BY emp_id, event_day;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT event_day AS day, emp_id, SUM(out_time - in_time) AS total_time FROM Employees GROUP BY emp_id, event_day;

content.description:
Для каждого `user_id` — последний вход (`last_stamp`) **в 2020 году**. Пользователи без входов в 2020 не выводятся.

[LeetCode 1890](https://leetcode.com/problems/the-latest-login-in-2020/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Logins(user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, time_stamp TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT user_id, MAX(time_stamp) AS last_stamp FROM Logins GROUP BY user_id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT user_id, MAX(time_stamp) AS last_stamp FROM Logins WHERE strftime('%Y', time_stamp) = '2020' GROUP BY user_id;

content.description:
Для каждой акции (`stock_name`) — `capital_gain_loss` = Σ(продажи) − Σ(покупки), т.е. сумма `price` со знаком минус для `Buy`.

[LeetCode 1393](https://leetcode.com/problems/capital-gainloss/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Stocks(stock_name TEXT NOT NULL, operation TEXT NOT NULL, price INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT stock_name, SUM(price) AS capital_gain_loss FROM Stocks GROUP BY stock_name;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT stock_name, SUM(CASE WHEN operation = 'Buy' THEN -price ELSE price END) AS capital_gain_loss FROM Stocks GROUP BY stock_name;

content.description:
По каждой `transaction_date`: `odd_sum` (сумма нечётных `amount`) и `even_sum` (сумма чётных), `0` если таких нет. Сортировка по дате.

[LeetCode 3220](https://leetcode.com/problems/odd-and-even-transactions/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE transactions(transaction_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, amount INTEGER NOT NULL, transaction_date TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT transaction_date, SUM(CASE WHEN amount % 2 = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS odd_sum, SUM(CASE WHEN amount % 2 = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS even_sum FROM transactions GROUP BY transaction_date ORDER BY transaction_date;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT transaction_date, SUM(CASE WHEN amount % 2 = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS odd_sum, SUM(CASE WHEN amount % 2 = 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS even_sum FROM transactions GROUP BY transaction_date ORDER BY transaction_date;
